import pytest

from cart import Cart


def test_total_includes_tax():
    cart = Cart(tax_rate=0.1)
    cart.add("towel", 12.50, quantity=2)
    cart.add("soap", 3.00)
    cart.add("brush", 4.25, quantity=4)
    assert cart.subtotal() == 45.0
    assert cart.total() == 49.5


def test_coupon_reduces_total():
    cart = Cart(tax_rate=0.1)
    cart.add("towel", 12.50, quantity=2)
    cart.add("soap", 3.00)
    cart.add("brush", 4.25, quantity=4)
    cart.apply_coupon("AUTUMN", 20)
    assert cart.subtotal() == 45.0
    assert cart.total() == 39.6


def test_remove_item():
    cart = Cart(tax_rate=0.1)
    cart.add("towel", 12.50, quantity=2)
    cart.add("soap", 3.00)
    cart.add("brush", 4.25, quantity=4)
    cart.remove("brush")
    assert sorted(cart.items) == ["soap", "towel"]
    assert cart.total() == 30.8


def test_adding_same_sku_accumulates():
    cart = Cart(tax_rate=0.1)
    cart.add("towel", 12.50, quantity=2)
    cart.add("soap", 3.00)
    cart.add("brush", 4.25, quantity=4)
    cart.add("soap", 3.00, quantity=2)
    assert cart.items["soap"] == (3.00, 3)
    assert cart.subtotal() == 51.0


def test_rejects_non_positive_quantity():
    cart = Cart()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cart.add("towel", 12.50, quantity=0)
    assert cart.items == {}
